title: int:Billing
description: Billing record aggregating all invoices for an Actor within a billing period at a Community/Site. Subclass of cim:MarketDocument.

billingId.description: Primary identifier. IRI: int:billingId. UUID v4.

communityId.description: FK to Community. IRI: int:communityId. UUID v4.

siteId.description: FK to Site. Optional — required when actor owns multiple sites. IRI: int:siteId. UUID v4.

memberId.description: FK to Actor being billed. IRI: int:memberId. UUID v4.

billingPeriodFrom.description: Start of the billing period. IRI: int:billingPeriodFrom. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

billingPeriodUntil.description: End of the billing period. IRI: int:billingPeriodUntil. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

overdueDate.description: Final settlement deadline. IRI: int:overdueDate. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

totalAmountDue.description: Total gross amount charged before any payments applied. IRI: int:totalAmountDue.

totalEnergyAmount.description: Cumulative energy cost component. IRI: int:totalEnergyAmount.

totalGridFeeAmount.description: Cumulative grid fee component. IRI: int:totalGridFeeAmount.

createdAt.description: Record creation timestamp. IRI: int:createdAt. ISO 8601 with timezone.

updatedAt.description: Record last updated timestamp. IRI: int:updatedAt. ISO 8601 with timezone.

invoiceIds.description: FKs to Invoices issued in this billing period. IRI: int:invoiceIds. UUID v4 array.
